title: Patch v0.2.Y: 3 new tags and naming conventions
notes: Three new tags: Catalyst on Solarius and Felinor Flagbearer, Prime on the tokens their Deaths shuffle in, and Acclaimed on BOOM! Big Max and Wardrum. Solarius-Prime is now Solarius Prime, spaced like Felinor Flagbearer Prime, and Solarius's text names it so. No card plays differently.
